name: Beech Blight Aphid
desc: Beech Blight Aphid (Grylloprociphilus imbricator): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The beech blight aphid is a small insect in the order Hemiptera that feeds primarily on the sap of American beech trees. The aphids form dense colonies on small branches and the undersides of leaves.
